Section 02 — Who We Are

We co-build digital infrastructure that nations own.

Arxia is a digital transformation consultancy specializing in Sovereign Technology. We design, build and implement the digital building blocks for countries to own their digital future.

We focus on creating interoperable systems that favor open-source, no-vendor lock, low-code, AI-powered, reusable, accessible, and citizen-centric technologies.

We've worked alongside governments and professionals from more than 20+ countries across Africa, Latin America, Eastern Europe, and Southeast Asia. We foster cooperation, community and capacity building with partners all over the world.

Our Principle

Sovereignty is co-built,
not bought.

Digital sovereignty means a nation controls its own digital infrastructure — the identity systems, data exchange layers, payment rails, and public services that citizens depend on every day.

It means no vendor lock-in. No foreign dependency. No black boxes.

We believe every nation deserves the technical capacity to build, own, and evolve its digital foundations. Our role is to make that possible.

"Partnership without dependency. Ownership without compromise."
Section 04 — Sovereign Stack

Proven technologies from the world's most advanced digital nations.

We implement, integrate, and adapt proven technology stacks developed by governments that have already solved the hard problems — made their solutions available as public goods — and adapt them to national realities.

Core Layer

Digital Public Infrastructure

DPI is the foundational layer of a digitally sovereign nation — the shared rails on which all government services, private sector innovation, and citizen interactions operate. Without it, digital transformation is just a collection of disconnected projects.

Digital Identity (e-ID)

Citizen identity verification and authentication systems. The trust layer. Every service depends on knowing who is on the other side.

Payments Core

National payment infrastructure enabling government-to-person, person-to-government, and institutional transfers. Interoperable, auditable, sovereign.

Data Exchange

Secure, standardized data exchange between government institutions. Based on X-Road and equivalent protocols. The nervous system of digital government.

Service Layer

Sovereign Systems and Services

On top of the infrastructure layer, we implement the building blocks of a functional digital government — following a principled approach: open-source, interoperable, reusable, and designed for the citizens who depend on them.

e-Services

Government digital services for citizens and businesses. From permits to certificates — accessible, fast, transparent.

AI Automation & Workflows

Intelligent process automation for government operations. Reducing bureaucratic burden. Accelerating decision cycles.

Government Web Portals

Unified citizen-facing portals. One entry point. Consistent experience. Accessible by design.

Government Applications

Custom applications for specific government needs — registries, case management, licensing, inspections.

e-Procurement

Transparent public procurement systems. Open competition. Auditable processes. Anti-corruption by architecture.

e-Invoicing

Standardized electronic invoicing aligned with international norms. Connecting government, businesses, and tax systems.

Interoperability and Data Exchange Systems

Secure, standardized data exchange between government systems and institutions. Enabling seamless integration across borders and agencies.

Knowledge Layer

International Expertise

We bring in international experts from across the globe to provide specialized consultancy services. Our network includes practitioners who have designed and implemented national-scale systems — not theorists who have only studied them.

Section 07 — Where to Start

Where to start?

Let's start by finding the gaps.

Every nation's digital infrastructure is at a different stage. Before building, we need to understand where you are — and plan together where you need to go.

The Arxia Digital Audit

Our Digital Audit maps your current infrastructure, identifies gaps, benchmarks against international standards, and produces an actionable roadmap — not a 200-page report that sits on a shelf.

You'll know exactly where you stand and what it takes to get where you need to go.

Assess
Current state assessment. Infrastructure, governance, capacity.
Phase 02
Map

Phase 03

Phase 04
Build
Co-build with your national team. Transfer. Own.
